reading.action: Careful, patient, sustained Ember-Tempered Body forging — draining the Furnace-heart, the fire-purged rivet, Burning Anger's bound charge, and his own held ember reserve completely dry as batteries, channeling every drop into hardening his flesh for as long as he has flesh left to burn.

check_careful_temper.note: HIGH band. Masterful sustained temper — the careful method proves out: Ember-Tempered Body PROMOTES Novice 3 -> Apprentice 1 (the clean demo it lacked). Direct body-forge gains VITALITY +2 (10->12), MIGHT +1 (13->14); derived Vitae(HP) 106->124, Stamina 68->76 (engine-confirmed). Control held clean so the self-burn stayed survivable despite enormous volume. EXPENDITURE (pours ember into flesh, drains his own reserve) -> NO affinity tick. Draining the Furnace-heart revealed it was FULL all along (corrects the t53 fumble — belief reconverges with truth).
